defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 7d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fetid Screech
offensiveAbilities.description:
Unaware that its vocal organs have withered and decayed, the straugh instinctively but ineffectively attempts to screech, instead releasing malodorous gas, half-digested corpse flesh, and small swarms of maggots from its open beak. The straugh releases a disgusting cloud of gas and decaying detritus in a 15ft Cone; any creature within the area must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 2. On a critical failure, the creature also takes a -5 foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. Any creature that succeeds at the save is temporarily immune to Fetid Screech for 24 hours.

Effect: Fetid Screech (Critical Failure)

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 4d8 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 4d8 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rock Tunneler
offensiveAbilities.description: A straugh can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 10 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tunneling Strike
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The straugh has Burrowed underground and remains undetected by the creature it plans to attack

Effect The straugh Burrows twice to emerge from the ground adjacent to at least one enemy and immediately makes a Strike against that foe.

offensiveAbilities.name: Improved Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Improved Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with as a free action. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Improved Grab as an action and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Improved Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
